title: Adaptive MIR Candidate Evaluation

adaptiveGates.description: Complete the MIR and AutoDJ candidate research dossier before final implementation requirements are locked.
Compare current and candidate backend outputs against Rekordbox XML ground truth before selecting winners.
Stop for user review in the HTML viewer and/or Rekordbox before final backend selection is treated as complete.

subagentExecutionRules: Before executing any task, read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, research-plan.md, and all requiredSteeringContext files.
This spec is adaptive: do not invent final backend choices before the research, benchmark, and manual-verdict gates have produced evidence.
Use primary sources for research wherever possible: papers, official repositories, official docs, and model cards.
Record source URLs, publication dates when available, licenses, install requirements, compute costs, model sizes, platform constraints, and observed output quality.
Keep real songs, Rekordbox exports, generated analysis artifacts, and local benchmark results out of git unless a task explicitly creates sanitized documentation.
Treat Rekordbox XML as the current ground-truth reference for user-provided known songs, but final acceptance requires user judgment.
Place BPM, beatgrid, and section systems behind interfaces so candidate backends can be swapped with minimal orchestration changes.
The current BPM and beatgrid analyzer should be treated as a strong incumbent; replace it only with measured improvement or clear operational benefit.
The current heuristic section labeler should be treated as disposable; do not overfit or preserve it unless evidence shows value.
Stop at manual checkpoint tasks and ask the user to inspect outputs before continuing selection work.
Update tasks.md checkboxes only after completing and verifying the specific task.
